scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @preform/web --if-present && cd apps/api && dotnet build
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @preform/web --if-present && cd apps/api && dotnet test
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && dotnet ef migrations bundle --output ../migrate --self-contained || echo 'EF Core tools required: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef'
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && dotnet ef database update
scripts.db:deploy: cd apps/api && dotnet ef database update
